subject: Newton Capital — sudden throughput loss & error spike after quant profile rollout
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@newtoncap.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Newton Capital Support <support@newtoncap.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden p95 jump + 502s after your 'qprofile-v3' rollout

Hi Rishi —

We started seeing a sharp regression at ~01:20 UTC after you rolled the qprofile-v3 variant into our prod pool. Symptoms:
- p95 latency jumped from ~180ms to ~1.3s for our short-chat endpoints
- overall throughput dropped by ~40% (requests/sec) despite no change in traffic from our side
- intermittent 502/504 errors and a handful of decoding failures (sample ids attached)

I attached p95_metrics_20280513.csv and sample_request_ids.txt. This is impacting hedge-strategy rebalances — P&L is sensitive to latency. We need an immediate remediation path and ETA.

Please advise whether you can rollback or route us to the previous model profile now. If a rollback requires a suspend window, we need to know how soon.

Sam
Head of Platform
Newton Capital

Attachments: p95_metrics_20280513.csv (csv), sample_request_ids.txt (txt)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@newtoncap.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 jump + 502s after your 'qprofile-v3' rollout

Sam —

Thank you for the data and the urgency. I'm escalating immediately to eng and CS. Short plan:
1) Can we perform an emergency canary rollback to qprofile-v2 (the baseline) and route Newton traffic back to the stable profile? This should restore throughput quickly.
2) Evelyn/Connor: please triage whether this is a decoding/quant tail latency regression or a kernel scheduling issue. Capture kernel traces and KV cache hit statistics.
3) Laura: I'll coordinate the customer comms and confirm whether Newton wants temporary capacity burst while we fix this.

Sam — I will ping you with an ETA within 20 minutes. If you approve rollback, please reply in-thread so we have explicit authorization to proceed.

— Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@newtoncap.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 jump + 502s after your 'qprofile-v3' rollout

Quick triage notes (initial):
- Observed increased decode time variance on the qprofile-v3 variant starting at 01:18 UTC. Median decode roughly unchanged, but 95/99 tail much higher.
- A subset of requests hit a fallback path that returns HTTP 502 after tokenizer decode errors — correlated to the sample IDs.
- KV-cache hit-rate unchanged, so not a cache invalidation issue.
- Telemetry shows a small but notable increase in per-request memory pressure on a subset of GPU instances with quantized kernels.

Immediate actions I'm proposing:
- Start canary rollback of Newton pool to qprofile-v2 (full rollback rather than partial) — low blast radius for this customer since they are on a dedicated route.
- Collect detailed kernel logs and decoder traces for the failing request ids (Connor, I'll need the request ids and the trace capture commands).
- If rollback is not approved, we can enable temporary routing to the previous stable model variant and scale up dedicated capacity for 30m while we debug.

Estimate: rollback + routing change ~15-30 minutes if no infra-side blockers. Will update slack when done.

Evelyn
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@newtoncap.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 jump + 502s after your 'qprofile-v3' rollout

Adding runbook context and technical plan:
- I'm initiating the Newton-cap dedicated pool rollback to qprofile-v2 now (see runbook steps). Expected steps: pause qprofile-v3 routing -> switch traffic -> validate p50/p95 -> re-enable autoscaling to baseline.
- I've attached the rollback runbook (rollback_runbook_v1.pdf) to this thread for audit.
- If we see decode failures persist after rollback, we will capture a full decode trace and escalate to kernel team — but rollback should avoid the new kernel path entirely.
- Risk: any in-flight requests during the switch may see transient 502s; we'll throttle the switch and drain in-flight sessions first.

ETA: 25 minutes to traffic steady-state. I'll post a verification snapshot once p95 returns to baseline.

Connor O'Brien
Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rollback_runbook_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@newtoncap.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 jump + 502s after your 'qprofile-v3' rollout

Sam —

Thanks for the prompt approval (reply below). We are initiating the rollback now and will preserve logs/traces for a post-mortem. Expected timeline ~25 minutes. We'll also provision a short burst of capacity to keep latency steady during the transition; this will be time-limited and I will follow up with billing/credits if the rollout caused user impact.

Tracking items for the follow-up post-mortem:
- Root cause: quant tail decode variance vs kernel selection mismatch
- Why the qprofile-v3 smoke/regression tests did not catch the tail behavior
- Action items: additional tail-focused tests, canary policy changes, and a rollback playbook update

I'll send a post-mortem skeleton in the thread and schedule a 30-min sync with Newton for tomorrow.

— Rishi

On Tue, May 14, 2028 at 08:09 AM Sam Patel <sam.patel@newtoncap.com> wrote:
> Rishi — please go ahead and roll us back. We need throughput restored ASAP.
> Sam

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@newtoncap.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 jump + 502s after your 'qprofile-v3' rollout

Team —

Thank you for the quick action. I can confirm the throughput and p95 are back to pre-rollout levels for our core endpoints. Appreciate the clear plan and the preservation of logs for a post-mortem.

Two asks as follow-ups:
1) Please share the post-mortem and timeline when available. We will need a short credit for the 45-minute impact window.
2) We expect a mitigation plan for future qprofile rollouts — ideally a checklist and a reduced blast policy for dedicated pools.

Sam
Head of Platform
Newton Capital
